issue_request: FHIR-47276 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core async-bundle and requested clarification that the first entry in the completed async Bundle represents the requested FHIR operation's final outcome, not the initial 202 Accepted kick-off response.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3211, merged as 2d3dbef772b8185b722a8b6d7279aa25ff58306d, applied the request in commit 38182bb49ab298faceb8522ec6686df7ba7cf854 by updating source/async-bundle.html with the requested-operation outcome text, field list, and explanatory note.
additional_context: FHIR-47277 later changed the same status-response paragraph's SHOULDs to SHALLs while retaining the old kick-off sentence. Commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd then deleted source/async-bundle.html from core during R6 normative changes and redirected core async guidance to the API Incubator. The external HL7/api-incubator-ig source contains the FHIR-47276 clarification but also still has the stale kick-off sentence, and the current rendered API Incubator URLs used by core returned 404 in this check.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Restoring or editing source/async-bundle.html would reintroduce a page that is no longer in the current core build scope, so the remaining cleanup belongs in the API Incubator repository/publication path.
